const TYPES=("A", "NS", "CNAME", "SOA", "PTR", "MX", "TXT", "AAAA")
const KINDS=("ANSWER", "CNAME", "REFERRAL", "NODATA", "NXDOMAIN", "LAME", "TIMEOUT")
const STATUSES=("NOERROR", "NODATA", "NXDOMAIN", "SERVFAIL")
const Name=Tuple{Vararg{String}}
const ROOT=()
struct InputError <: Exception
    message::String
end
fail(s) = throw(InputError(s))
require(b, s) = b ? nothing : fail(s)
part(s, a, b = length(s)) = a>b ? "" : String(s[a:b])
integerword(s) = occursin(r"^(?:0|[1-9][0-9]{0,8})$", s)
function ipv4(s)
    fields=split(s, '.'; keepempty = true)
    length(fields)==4 && all(x->occursin(r"^(?:0|[1-9][0-9]{0,2})$", x), fields) ||
        fail("bad address $s")
    values=parse.(Int, fields)
    all(<=(255), values) || fail("bad address $s")
    foldl((a, b)->a*256+b, values; init = 0)
end
ip4text(n) = join([div(n, 256^i)%256 for i in 3:-1:0], '.')
function groups(s)
    isempty(s) && return Int[]
    parts=split(s, ':'; keepempty = true)
    all(x->occursin(r"^[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}$", x), parts) || return nothing
    parse.(Int, parts; base = 16)
end
function ipv6(s)
    parts=split(s, "::"; limit = 2, keepempty = true)
    if length(parts)==1
        values=groups(s)
        values!==nothing && length(values)==8 || fail("bad address $s")
        return Tuple(values)
    end
    front=groups(parts[1])
    back=groups(parts[2])
    front!==nothing && back!==nothing && length(front)+length(back)<=7 || fail("bad address $s")
    Tuple([front; zeros(Int, 8-length(front)-length(back)); back])
end
function ip6text(values)
    best=0
    width=1
    at=1
    while at<=8
        stop=at
        while stop<=8 && values[stop]==0
            stop+=1
        end
        if stop-at>width
            best=at
            width=stop-at
        end
        at=max(stop, at+1)
    end
    parts=[string(x; base = 16) for x in values]
    best==0 ? join(parts, ':') :
    join(parts[1:(best-1)], ':')*"::"*join(parts[(best+width):end], ':')
end
function parsename(s; wildcard = false, origin = nothing)
    origin!==nothing && s=="@" && return origin
    s=="." && return ROOT
    absolute=endswith(s, ".")
    fields=split(absolute ? part(s, 1, length(s)-1) : s, '.'; keepempty = true)
    for (i, label) in enumerate(fields)
        wildcard && i==1 && label=="*" && continue
        occursin(r"^[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9-]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9])?$", label) || fail("bad name $s")
    end
    name=Tuple(lowercase.(String.(fields)))
    origin!==nothing && !absolute ? (name..., origin...) : name
end
nametext(n) = isempty(n) ? "." : join(n, '.')*"."
namekey(n) = reverse(n)
below(n, a) = length(n)>=length(a) && n[(length(n)-length(a)+1):end]==a
ancestors(n) = [n[i:end] for i in 1:(length(n)+1)]
function ttlword(s)
    if integerword(s)
        n=parse(Int, s)
    else
        pairs=collect(eachmatch(r"(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,2})([wWdDhHmMsS])", s))
        join(m.match for m in pairs)==s && !isempty(pairs) || fail("bad ttl $s")
        previous=0
        n=0
        for m in pairs
            at=findfirst(==(lowercase(m.captures[2])[1]), "wdhms")
            at>previous || fail("bad ttl $s")
            previous=at
            n+=parse(Int, m.captures[1])*(604800, 86400, 3600, 60, 1)[at]
        end
    end
    require(1<=n<=604800, "bad ttl $s")
    n
end
checktype(s) = require(s in TYPES, "bad type $s")
function parsedata(kind, fields, origin)
    kind=="A" && return ipv4(fields[1])
    kind=="AAAA" && return ipv6(fields[1])
    kind in ("NS", "CNAME", "PTR") && return parsename(fields[1]; origin)
    if kind=="MX"
        require(
            integerword(fields[1]) && parse(Int, fields[1])<=65535,
            "bad preference $(fields[1])",
        )
        return (parse(Int, fields[1]), parsename(fields[2]; origin))
    end
    if kind=="TXT"
        s=join(fields, ' ')
        require(
            length(s)>=2 && s[1]=='"' && s[end]=='"' && !('"' in part(s, 2, length(s)-1)),
            "bad text $s",
        )
        return s
    end
    first=parsename(fields[1]; origin)
    second=parsename(fields[2]; origin)
    numbers=Int[]
    for s in fields[3:6]
        require(integerword(s), "bad number $s")
        push!(numbers, parse(Int, s))
    end
    s=fields[7]
    require(integerword(s) && 1<=parse(Int, s)<=86400, "bad minimum $s")
    (first, second, numbers..., parse(Int, s))
end
struct Record
    owner::Name
    ttl::Int
    kind::String
    data::Any
end
withttl(r, t) = Record(r.owner, t, r.kind, r.data)
withowner(r, n) = Record(n, r.ttl, r.kind, r.data)
samerecord(a, b) = a.owner==b.owner && a.kind==b.kind && a.data==b.data
datakey(r) =
    r.kind in ("NS", "CNAME", "PTR") ? namekey(r.data) :
    r.kind=="MX" ? (r.data[1], namekey(r.data[2])) : r.data
recordkey(r) = (namekey(r.owner), findfirst(==(r.kind), TYPES), datakey(r))
dataorder(records) = sort(records; by = datakey)
function datatext(r)
    r.kind=="A" && return ip4text(r.data)
    r.kind=="AAAA" && return ip6text(r.data)
    r.kind in ("NS", "CNAME", "PTR") && return nametext(r.data)
    r.kind=="MX" && return string(r.data[1])*" "*nametext(r.data[2])
    r.kind=="SOA" && return nametext(r.data[1])*" "*nametext(r.data[2])*" "*join(r.data[3:end], ' ')
    r.data
end
recordtext(r) = nametext(r.owner)*" $(r.ttl) $(r.kind) "*datatext(r)
mutable struct Zone
    origin::Name
    server::Int
    line::Int
    records::Vector{Record}
end
atowner(z, n) = [r for r in z.records if r.owner==n]
findrecords(z, n, t) = dataorder([r for r in z.records if r.owner==n && r.kind==t])
exists(z, n) = any(r->below(r.owner, n), z.records)
soa(z) = z.records[findfirst(r->r.kind=="SOA", z.records)]
struct Response
    kind::String
    answer::Vector{Record}
    authority::Vector{Record}
    additional::Vector{Record}
    referral::Name
end
Response(k; answer = Record[], authority = Record[], additional = Record[], referral = ROOT) =
    Response(k, answer, authority, additional, referral)
response_summary(r) =
    r.kind=="REFERRAL" ? "REFERRAL "*nametext(r.referral) :
    r.kind=="CNAME" ? "CNAME "*nametext(r.answer[1].data) : r.kind
struct Entry
    kind::String
    records::Vector{Record}
    expiry::Int
end
mutable struct Resolver
    roots::Vector{Int}
    zones::Vector{Zone}
    current::Int
    down::Set{Int}
    clock::Int
    cache::Dict{Tuple{Name,String},Entry}
    settings::Dict{String,Int}
    queries::Dict{Int,Vector{Int}}
    hits::Int
    resolutions::Vector{Int}
end
Resolver() = Resolver(
    Int[],
    Zone[],
    0,
    Set{Int}(),
    0,
    Dict{Tuple{Name,String},Entry}(),
    Dict("MINTTL"=>1, "MAXTTL"=>86400, "NEGTTL"=>3600),
    Dict{Int,Vector{Int}}(),
    0,
    zeros(Int, 4),
)
function zoneinput!(s, line, number)
    words=String.(split(line, ' '))
    command=words[1]
    if command=="ROOT"
        addresses=Int[]
        for word in words[2:end]
            n=ipv4(word)
            require(!(n in s.roots || n in addresses), "duplicate root $word")
            push!(addresses, n)
        end
        append!(s.roots, addresses)
    elseif command=="ZONE"
        s.current=0
        origin=parsename(words[2])
        server=ipv4(words[3])
        require(
            !any(z->z.origin==origin && z.server==server, s.zones),
            "duplicate zone $(nametext(origin)) at $(words[3])",
        )
        push!(s.zones, Zone(origin, server, number, Record[]))
        s.current=length(s.zones)
    else
        require(s.current!=0, "no current zone")
        z=s.zones[s.current]
        owner=parsename(words[1]; wildcard = true, origin = z.origin)
        require(below(owner, z.origin), "out of zone $(nametext(owner))")
        ttl=ttlword(words[2])
        kind=words[3]
        checktype(kind)
        fields=words[4:end]
        counts=Dict("A"=>1, "AAAA"=>1, "NS"=>1, "CNAME"=>1, "PTR"=>1, "MX"=>2, "SOA"=>7)
        require(!haskey(counts, kind) || length(fields)==counts[kind], "wrong field count")
        r=Record(owner, ttl, kind, parsedata(kind, fields, z.origin))
        require(!(kind=="NS" && !isempty(owner) && owner[1]=="*"), "ns at wildcard")
        require(kind!="SOA" || owner==z.origin, "soa not at origin")
        require(kind!="SOA" || !any(x->x.kind=="SOA", z.records), "duplicate soa")
        require(!any(x->samerecord(x, r), z.records), "duplicate record")
        existing=atowner(z, owner)
        require(
            !(
                (kind=="CNAME" && !isempty(existing)) ||
                (kind!="CNAME" && any(x->x.kind=="CNAME", existing))
            ),
            "cname conflict $(nametext(owner))",
        )
        push!(z.records, r)
    end
end
function finishzones!(s)
    kept=Zone[]
    for z in s.zones
        label="zone $(nametext(z.origin)) at $(ip4text(z.server))"
        if any(r->r.kind=="SOA", z.records)
            println(label, " records=$(length(z.records))")
            push!(kept, z)
        else
            println("error line $(z.line): $label has no soa")
        end
    end
    s.zones=kept
    println(
        "loaded roots=$(length(s.roots)) zones=$(length(kept)) records=$(sum(z->length(z.records),kept;init=0))",
    )
end
reachable(s, a) = !(a in s.down) && any(z->z.server==a, s.zones)
function dnsresponse(s, server, name, kind, cut)
    reachable(s, server) || return Response("TIMEOUT")
    candidates=[z for z in s.zones if z.server==server && below(name, z.origin)]
    isempty(candidates) && return Response("LAME")
    z=candidates[argmax(length(z.origin) for z in candidates)]
    length(z.origin)>=length(cut) || return Response("LAME")
    for n in (length(z.origin)+1):length(name)
        point=name[(length(name)-n+1):end]
        ns=findrecords(z, point, "NS")
        if !isempty(ns)
            glue=Record[]
            for r in ns
                append!(glue, findrecords(z, r.data, "A"))
            end
            return Response("REFERRAL"; authority = ns, additional = glue, referral = point)
        end
    end
    records=atowner(z, name)
    if isempty(records)
        exists(z, name) && return Response("NODATA"; authority = [soa(z)])
        closest=first(a for a in ancestors(name)[2:end] if exists(z, a))
        records=atowner(z, ("*", closest...))
        isempty(records) && return Response("NXDOMAIN"; authority = [soa(z)])
    end
    records=withowner.(records, Ref(name))
    matching=dataorder([r for r in records if r.kind==kind])
    !isempty(matching) && return Response("ANSWER"; answer = matching)
    cnames=[r for r in records if r.kind=="CNAME"]
    kind!="CNAME" && !isempty(cnames) && return Response("CNAME"; answer = cnames)
    Response("NODATA"; authority = [soa(z)])
end
function dnsask!(s, a, n, t, c)
    response=dnsresponse(s, a, n, t, c)
    counts=get!(()->zeros(Int, 7), s.queries, a)
    counts[findfirst(==(response.kind), KINDS)]+=1
    response
end
function positive!(s, records)
    ttl=min(max(minimum(r.ttl for r in records), s.settings["MINTTL"]), s.settings["MAXTTL"])
    first=records[1]
    s.cache[(first.owner, first.kind)]=Entry("POS", dataorder(records), s.clock+ttl)
    ttl
end
function negative!(s, name, kind, r)
    soa=r.authority[1]
    ttl=min(soa.ttl, soa.data[end], s.settings["NEGTTL"])
    s.cache[(name, kind)]=Entry(r.kind, Record[], s.clock+ttl)
end
function positiveentry(s, name, kind)
    e=get(s.cache, (name, kind), nothing)
    e!==nothing && e.kind=="POS" ? e : nothing
end
aged(s, e) = [withttl(r, e.expiry-s.clock) for r in e.records]
trace(d, message) = println(repeat("  ", d+1), message)
function dnslookup!(s, name, kind, depth, pending)
    entry=get(s.cache, (name, kind), nothing)
    cached=nothing
    if entry!==nothing
        cached=Response(
            entry.kind=="POS" ? "ANSWER" : entry.kind;
            answer = entry.kind=="POS" ? aged(s, entry) : Record[],
        )
    elseif any(kv->kv.second.kind=="NXDOMAIN" && below(name, kv.first[1]), s.cache)
        cached=Response("NXDOMAIN")
    elseif kind!="CNAME"
        e=positiveentry(s, name, "CNAME")
        e!==nothing && (cached=Response("CNAME"; answer = aged(s, e)))
    end
    query=nametext(name)*" "*kind
    if cached!==nothing
        s.hits+=1
        trace(depth, "CACHE HIT $query -> $(response_summary(cached))")
        return cached
    end
    cut=ROOT
    nameservers=nothing
    for ancestor in ancestors(name)
        e=positiveentry(s, ancestor, "NS")
        if e!==nothing
            s.hits+=1
            trace(depth, "CACHE HIT $query -> REFERRAL $(nametext(ancestor))")
            cut=ancestor
            nameservers=[r.data for r in e.records]
            break
        end
    end
    while true
        response=nothing
        hosts=nameservers===nothing ? [nothing] : sort(nameservers; by = namekey)
        for host in hosts
            addresses=Int[]
            if host===nothing
                addresses=s.roots
            else
                e=positiveentry(s, host, "A")
                if e!==nothing
                    addresses=sort(unique([r.data for r in e.records]))
                elseif (host, "A") in pending
                    trace(depth, "GLUELESS $(nametext(host)) -> LOOP")
                else
                    trace(depth, "GLUELESS $(nametext(host))")
                    status, answer=dnsresolve!(s, host, "A", depth+1, pending)
                    status=="NOERROR" &&
                        (addresses=sort(unique([r.data for r in answer if r.kind=="A"])))
                end
            end
            for address in addresses
                r=dnsask!(s, address, name, kind, cut)
                trace(depth, "ASK $(ip4text(address)) $query -> $(response_summary(r))")
                if !(r.kind in ("LAME", "TIMEOUT"))
                    response=r
                    break
                end
            end
            response!==nothing && break
        end
        response===nothing && return Response("SERVFAIL no server for "*nametext(cut))
        if response.kind=="REFERRAL"
            positive!(s, response.authority)
            owners=unique([r.owner for r in response.additional])
            for owner in owners
                positive!(s, [r for r in response.additional if r.owner==owner])
            end
            cut=response.referral
            nameservers=[r.data for r in response.authority]
        elseif response.kind in ("ANSWER", "CNAME")
            ttl=positive!(s, response.answer)
            return Response(response.kind; answer = [withttl(r, ttl) for r in response.answer])
        else
            negative!(s, name, kind, response)
            return Response(response.kind)
        end
    end
end
function dnsresolve!(s, name, kind, depth = 0, pending = Tuple{Name,String}[])
    pending=[pending; [(name, kind)]]
    chain=Record[]
    seen=Set{Name}([name])
    current=name
    response=Response("")
    while true
        response=dnslookup!(s, current, kind, depth, pending)
        response.kind!="CNAME" && break
        append!(chain, response.answer)
        target=response.answer[1].data
        if target in seen
            response=Response("SERVFAIL cname loop")
            break
        end
        if length(chain)==9
            response=Response("SERVFAIL cname chain too long")
            break
        end
        push!(seen, target)
        current=target
    end
    status=response.kind=="ANSWER" ? "NOERROR" : response.kind
    answer=startswith(status, "SERVFAIL") ? Record[] : [chain; response.answer]
    label=startswith(status, "SERVFAIL") ? "SERVFAIL" : status
    s.resolutions[findfirst(==(label), STATUSES)]+=1
    status, answer
end
function report!(s, name, kind)
    status, answer=dnsresolve!(s, name, kind)
    for r in answer
        println("answer ", recordtext(r))
    end
    println("status ", status)
    status, answer
end
function addressresolution!(s, host)
    addresses=String[]
    for kind in ("A", "AAAA")
        status, answer=dnsresolve!(s, host, kind)
        status=="NOERROR" && append!(addresses, [datatext(r) for r in answer if r.kind==kind])
    end
    isempty(addresses) ? "no address" : join(addresses, ' ')
end
function execute!(s, line)
    w=String.(split(line, ' '))
    command=w[1]
    if command in ("RESOLVE", "MX")
        name=parsename(w[2]; wildcard = true)
        kind=command=="MX" ? "MX" : w[3]
        checktype(kind)
        println(command=="MX" ? "mx $(nametext(name))" : "resolve $(nametext(name)) $kind")
        status, answer=report!(s, name, kind)
        if command=="MX"
            if status=="NOERROR"
                for r in answer
                    r.kind=="MX" || continue
                    preference, host=r.data
                    println(
                        "exchange $preference $(nametext(host)) -> ",
                        isempty(host) ? "null" : addressresolution!(s, host),
                    )
                end
            elseif status=="NODATA"
                host=isempty(answer) ? name : answer[end].data
                addresses=addressresolution!(s, host)
                println("implicit $(nametext(host)) -> $addresses")
            end
        end
    elseif command=="REVERSE"
        if ':' in w[2]
            hextets=ipv6(w[2])
            address=ip6text(hextets)
            digits=join(lpad(string(x; base = 16), 4, '0') for x in hextets)
            name=(string.(reverse(collect(digits)))..., "ip6", "arpa")
        else
            n=ipv4(w[2])
            address=ip4text(n)
            name=(reverse(String.(split(address, '.')))..., "in-addr", "arpa")
        end
        println("reverse $address $(nametext(name))")
        report!(s, name, "PTR")
    elseif command=="QUERY"
        address=ipv4(w[2])
        name=parsename(w[3]; wildcard = true)
        checktype(w[4])
        response=dnsask!(s, address, name, w[4], ROOT)
        println(
            "query $(ip4text(address)) $(nametext(name)) $(w[4]) -> $(response_summary(response))",
        )
        for (label, records) in (
                ("answer", response.answer),
                ("authority", response.authority),
                ("additional", response.additional),
            ),
            r in records

            println(label, " ", recordtext(r))
        end
    elseif command=="DUMP"
        address=ipv4(w[2])
        name=parsename(w[3])
        prefix="dump $(ip4text(address)) $(nametext(name))"
        if !reachable(s, address)
            println(prefix, " -> TIMEOUT")
        else
            at=findfirst(z->z.server==address && z.origin==name, s.zones)
            if at===nothing
                println(prefix, " -> REFUSED")
            else
                z=s.zones[at]
                println(prefix, " records=$(length(z.records))")
                for r in sort(z.records; by = recordkey)
                    println("  ", recordtext(r))
                end
            end
        end
    elseif command in ("DOWN", "UP")
        address=ipv4(w[2])
        require(
            command=="DOWN" ? !(address in s.down) : address in s.down,
            "server $(w[2]) "*(command=="DOWN" ? "already down" : "not down"),
        )
        command=="DOWN" ? push!(s.down, address) : delete!(s.down, address)
        println(lowercase(command), " ", ip4text(address))
    elseif command=="SET"
        key=w[2]
        require(haskey(s.settings, key), "bad setting $key")
        require(integerword(w[3]) && 1<=parse(Int, w[3])<=604800, "bad value $(w[3])")
        value=parse(Int, w[3])
        next=copy(s.settings)
        next[key]=value
        require(next["MINTTL"]<=next["MAXTTL"], "minttl above maxttl")
        s.settings=next
        println("set $key=$value")
    elseif command=="TIME"
        require(integerword(w[2]) && 1<=parse(Int, w[2])<=1000000, "bad time $(w[2])")
        s.clock+=parse(Int, w[2])
        expired=[k for (k, e) in s.cache if e.expiry<=s.clock]
        for k in expired
            delete!(s.cache, k)
        end
        println("time now=$(s.clock) expired=$(length(expired))")
    elseif command in ("CACHE", "FLUSH")
        name=length(w)==1 ? nothing : parsename(w[2])
        selected=[k for k in keys(s.cache) if name===nothing || below(k[1], name)]
        if command=="FLUSH"
            for k in selected
                delete!(s.cache, k)
            end
            println("flush removed=$(length(selected))")
        else
            sort!(selected; by = k->(namekey(k[1]), findfirst(==(k[2]), TYPES)))
            println("cache entries=$(length(selected))")
            for k in selected
                e=s.cache[k]
                if e.kind=="POS"
                    for r in aged(s, e)
                        println("  ", recordtext(r))
                    end
                else
                    println("  $(nametext(k[1])) $(e.expiry-s.clock) $(k[2]) $(e.kind)")
                end
            end
        end
    elseif command=="STATS"
        println("stats queries=$(sum(x->sum(x),values(s.queries);init=0)) hits=$(s.hits)")
        for a in sort(collect(keys(s.queries)))
            counts=s.queries[a]
            println(
                "  $(ip4text(a)) sent=$(sum(counts)) ",
                join([lowercase(KINDS[i])*"=$(counts[i])" for i in 1:7], ' '),
            )
        end
        println(
            "resolutions ",
            join([lowercase(STATUSES[i])*"=$(s.resolutions[i])" for i in 1:4], ' '),
        )
    end
end
function main()
    resolver=Resolver()
    zones=true
    for (number, line) in enumerate(eachline())
        line=="END" && !zones && break
        if zones && line=="END ZONES"
            finishzones!(resolver)
            zones=false
            continue
        end
        try
            zones ? zoneinput!(resolver, line, number) : execute!(resolver, line)
        catch e
            e isa InputError || rethrow()
            println("error line $number: $(e.message)")
        end
    end
end
main()
